typing: D,n,s are natural numbers; N=n+1 is always positive.
Input is N already-materialized cores A_i, each D by 2D, and real boundary vectors l,r of length D.
Each local column is the pair (b,j), b in {0,1}, j in Fin D, represented through the named finProdFinEquiv.
K(t,b) is a real D by D semantic slice; x is an N-bit word (the word carrier is implicit in the displayed coefficient).
source_premises_for_semantics: Only A_i(a,(b,j)) = K(s+i,b)_(a,j) for 0 <= i < N is required.
All local tables and l,r are stored before the producer begins.
source_premises_for_cost: Stored input shape and positive word length N=n+1.
The specified additive exact-real field/read/write charging model; no semantic window or kernel evaluation is needed.
explicit_nonpremises: Nonzero data, nonsingularity, positive entries, normalization, rank or successful preparation
Any kernel-entry oracle available to or called by the producer
Any assumed correctness or bond property of the output
contract.order_and_phase: l^T is the ordinary real transpose, not a conjugate transpose. Slices are multiplied in increasing position s,...,s+N-1; each b is paired with the outgoing bond j. This is a real scalar tensor contraction, not a quantum-state convention. No qubit endianness, physical basis embedding or phase/ancilla convention is supplied or required for this classical contract.
contract.success_error: Exact equalities; no approximation norm, precision, success probability, postselection or amplification claim.

regions.content: Small products become a scalar-boundary tensor train without an all-bit-string table; already-stored inputs enable an exact-real arithmetic/stored-word cost for the same returned chain, not finite-bit time.
D,n,s natural; N=n+1; core shape D by 2D; (b,j) column pairing via finProdFinEquiv; real l,r of length D.
Semantic real slices and displayed finite-window equality A_i(a,(b,j))=K(s+i,b)_(a,j), 0<=i<N.
K is specification only, never called by producer; no condition outside the stored window.
Displayed desired coefficient l^T K(s,x_0)...K(s+N-1,x_(N-1))r, ordered left to right.
Signed, singular, zero data and D=0 allowed; normalization, positivity, rank and successful-preparation assumptions explicitly absent.
Last stored core is right-contracted with r to materialize D by 2 table T; displayed finite-sum entry formula.

Earlier tables are retained; recursive first-table read, tail-reference collect, tail build, first-node allocation; terminal table read, T materialization and core plus empty-tail allocation; no all-word amplitude expansion.
Displayed left absorption B(0,(b,j))=sum_(a<D) l_a A(a,(b,j)), with A the first core of the right-closed chain.
Materialize B, allocate a replacement first node, retain tail; N=1 uses terminal T as A so both boundaries enter one scalar core.
Finite-sum evaluation establishes both entry formulas for actual returned materialized tables; tail proof begins by induction on n.
First core agrees by window, remaining window begins s+1, collected references are original entries i+1; inductive tail and mathematical left absorption agree.
The single stored result denotes exactly ofKernel(K,l,r,s,n), and all contracted coefficients equal a(x); G01-G02 expose mathematical substrate not defined here.
Actual chain has scalar boundaries and maxBond<=max(D,1), obtained by refinement plus separate mathematical bond theorem, not assumed as output premise; G03 records missing theorem expansion.
Run returns value and eight natural counters; bind adds counters; total is their sum; only field/read/write used, no roots/angles/trigonometric/comparison/rotation generation.
Matrix lookup=two reads, boundary lookup=one; every D-sum term uses three reads plus multiplication plus addition to recursive accumulator; empty sum returns zero at zero term cost.
Collect m callback results charges callbacks plus 2m reads and 2m writes; nested u by v materialization overhead is 2(uv+u) each; callbacks are costed producers, not free semantic formulas.
R,W,F are separate unit counters; r_out outgoing dimension; following formulas are counter-vector identities.
C_terminalEntry=D(3R+2F).
C_initialEntry=D(3R+2F).
C_terminal=2D^2(3R+2F)+6D(R+W).
C_initial=2r_out D(3R+2F)+(4r_out+2)(R+W).
C_tailTable=n(3R+2W); display delimiters included.
Terminal table has 2D entries with D terms each; nested-vector materialization has 3D output/row positions, hence 6D reads and 6D writes.
Tail-reference formula includes one callback read plus four collect units per reference; scalar tables are not copied.
Sum the eight counters, rather than reinterpret as elapsed time.
Exact terminal total 10D^2+12D.
Exact initial total 10r_out D+8r_out+4.
Exact tail-reference total 5n; display closing delimiter included.
Chain-node allocation costs three reads and three writes; first input-table read costs one read.
Terminal tail total=10D^2+12D+13; induction step adds 1+5(n+1)+6 to shorter tail; recurrence is conservative-polynomial bound input.
Displayed tail-chain bound <=10D^2+12D+5n^2+7n+13.
For left absorption, r_out=1 when N=1, r_out=D otherwise; add replacement-node cost to exact initial materialization.
Displayed close-left bound <=10D^2+18D+18, valid in both cases including D=0.
Add tail and left counters to get whole-run total <=20D^2+30D+5n^2+7n+31.
Returned-value refinement and bound refer to the same result; stored input data suffice for cost.
Window is used only to identify output with K; entrywise window gives full array equality by extensionality.
D=0 and N=1 remain admitted. Single scalar core still materializes two zero entries; empty sums erase only term costs, not materialization or node costs.
Source claims whole-module correspondence to QuantumBlockEncoding.StoredMatrixProductChain; implementation is withheld, so ownership is not independently verified.

source_derived_checks.derivation: terminal: F=4D^2, R=6D^2+6D, W=6D, total=10D^2+12D. initial: F=4r_out D, R=6r_out D+4r_out+2, W=4r_out+2, total=10r_out D+8r_out+4. tailTable: R=3n,W=2n,total=5n. All other five counters are zero.
source_derived_checks.status: Reviewer algebra from displayed source; no formal verification claimed.

source_derived_checks.label: Tail induction indexing
source_derived_checks.derivation: Let f(n)=10D^2+12D+5n^2+7n+13. f(0) equals terminal total. The stated recurrence step at n to n+1 adds 5n+12; f(n+1)-f(n)=10n+12 >=5n+12 for every natural n. This resolves n in the recurrence as the shorter tail parameter.
source_derived_checks.status: Source-derived induction detail, not an amended theorem or inferred implementation.

source_derived_checks.label: Two close-left cases
source_derived_checks.derivation: n=0: exact initial+node=10D+18 <=10D^2+18D+18 since 10D^2+8D>=0. n>0: exact initial+node=10D^2+8D+10 <=10D^2+18D+18. No D>0 division or rank premise occurs.
source_derived_checks.status: Source-derived elementary bound; the theorem remains conservative.

source_derived_checks.label: N=1 coefficient
source_derived_checks.derivation: B(0,(b,0))=sum_a l_a*(sum_j A_0(a,(b,j))*r_j), equal under the finite window to l^T K(s,b)r. This uses T as input to left absorption, not a swapped boundary order.
source_derived_checks.status: Finite-sum expansion of source construction, not new producer semantics.

source_derived_checks.label: D=0 edge
source_derived_checks.derivation: Terminal D by 2 table is empty; left B is one by two with zero-valued empty sums. In N=1, initial materialization total is 12 and replacement node costs 6; terminal tail base costs 13. Whole bound at D=n=0 is 31. This is consistent with the source's warning about nonzero materialization costs.
